publication_copy: Fast accessibility fixes for public business websites. We audit 3-5 pages, repair visible contrast, keyboard focus, labels, and missing alt text issues, and leave a short QA summary. Fixed-price package: 149 EUR. Reference: RANK-IAMO513. Payment via CobrAMO: https://cobramo.netlify.app/
notes: We kept the offer tightly scoped and visibly useful: it addresses concrete, common accessibility issues on real lead-generation websites, avoids legal-compliance overstatement, and makes the action easy to understand and price. The prospects are selected from public business contact pages and official websites, prioritizing clinics and service businesses where conversion depends on usability and trust.
